artworks.title: Oui, on veut dépouiller cet orphelin...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a courtroom scene. A lawyer is gesturing passionately while three other figures appear disinterested or tired. The setting shows a courtroom with dynamic and static figures, highlighting a contrast in their actions. The grayscale tones and detailed line work create depth within the scene, conveying a mix of humor and criticism towards legal proceedings.

artworks.title: Et dire que voila trois... prévenu que je n'ai pas pu faire condamner!...
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals, a woman and a man, in full-body view. The woman is on the left, leaning slightly towards the man, who has his arms crossed. Both have exaggerated facial features. The woman has a prominent nose, looks to the right, and has dark hair styled in an updo, wearing a patterned dress with long sleeves. The man has wide, round eyes, a large nose, and short hair styled upwards. He wears a formal suit with tails. In the background is a framed portrait of a man with glasses holding a book, above the two figures. The setting seems to be indoors with a visible doorway on the right side.

artworks.title: Dites donc, confrère, vous allez soutenir...
artworks.description: The image shows two men engaged in a conversation. The man on the left has slicked-back hair and a hooked nose, wearing a robe with a white bow tie. The man on the right has curly hair and a mustache, also wearing a robe with a white tie. Both are holding the edges of their robes and appear to be adjusting them. In the background, dark curtains are visible on the left, and on the right, there is a table with a folded item and a round object. The setting has a smoky-textured backdrop.

artworks.title: Vous aviez faim... ce n'est pas une raison...
artworks.description: This is a monochromatic drawing depicting a courtroom scene. In the image, a judge is shown dozing off in his chair while a man, likely a defendant, stands nearby with a guard behind him. The judge is portrayed reclining with crossed arms, dressed in judicial robes and a hat. The defendant seems to be observing the judge with a skeptical or annoyed expression, standing next to a table cluttered with papers and an inkpot. Behind the judge, there is a sizable empty frame or window. The image includes text at the top and bottom, with the title "Les Gens de Justice" and dialogue suggesting a moral judgment theme.

artworks.title: Mr. l'avocat a rendu pleine justice...
artworks.description: This is a black and white drawing of a courtroom scene. The image shows a figure in black robes engaging in a legal argument and leaning over a bench. Other figures in formal attire are present, creating a courtroom environment. In the background, individuals are observed sitting and watching the proceedings with different expressions. The drawing is in the style of Honoré Daumier, known for his satirical portrayal of legal and societal themes. It captures a moment of tension and drama typical in judicial settings with exaggerated features highlighting the emotional and dynamic scene.

artworks.title: Voyons témoin il serait important de...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a courtroom scene. In the image, one central figure is standing in the foreground, facing slightly to the right, appearing engaged. Two figures in judicial attire are seated at a bench in the background. Another figure, possibly a legal professional or court officer, is seated at a desk, looking up with interest at the standing figure. The drawing uses bold lines typical of courtroom sketches and conveys a formal atmosphere. The scene is in grayscale. Words inscribed at the bottom suggest a dialogue or interrogation.

artworks.title: Maitre Chapotard lisant... l'éloge de lui-même...
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing and reading a document. He has a round face, glasses, a prominent nose, and curly hair under a hat. He wears a long dark robe with a white collar. Other men around him are dressed similarly and engaged with papers. The background has simple architectural features. The illustration is monochromatic, emphasizing the formal setting.

artworks.title: Ce qui m'chiffonne c'est... douze vols!...
artworks.description: The image is a black-and-white illustration showing two men in what appears to be an indoor setting. One man is seated on a simple wooden bench, his body shown from head to toe. He is leaning back slightly, elbows resting on the sides of the bench, with his legs stretched out in front of him. He has a receding hairline, leaving a bald patch on the top of his head, with short hair around the sides. He has a prominent nose and a contemplative expression, with a small moustache and beard. He is wearing a light-colored outfit, consisting of a suit with a cravat and trousers, and beside him on the bench is a cap. The other man is standing upright, his body visible from head to knees. He wears a top hat and spectacles, with a chubby face and a knowing smile. His hair is not visible due to the hat. He is dressed in a dark suit with a waistcoat. The background is textured, with vertical lines suggesting bars.

artworks.title: Mon cher monsieur... impossible de plaider votre affaire
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing. The man on the left is holding a bundle of papers close to his chest. He has a wrinkled face, a prominent nose, and is wearing a checkered robe with a distinctive cap. The man on the right has his arms crossed, long disheveled hair, a narrow face, and is dressed in a dark coat and light-colored pants. The background includes large signs on a wall, with one displaying the word "VENTE". Another figure in a dark robe and cap is walking away in the background.

artworks.title: Voila le ministère public qui vous dit des choses... désagréables...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a courtroom scene. Figures are depicted in traditional courtroom attire, including robes and hats. There is a prominent interaction between two figures in the foreground, one leaning in towards the other. Faintly sketched figures in the background may indicate an audience or additional court members. The artwork is monochrome, using shades of gray to create depth and focus on expressions and body language of the foreground figures.

artworks.title: Il défend l'orphelin et la veuve, a moins...
artworks.description: Three figures are depicted, a man and a woman sitting with a child. The man is standing behind a wooden surface. His facial features show wide-open eyes and a slightly agape mouth. His curly hair is slightly disheveled. He is wearing a traditional judicial robe with a cravat and there is a top hat on the table. The woman is wearing a dark cloak that covers her head. The child is crouched next to her in a dark garment. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Au Café d'Aguesseau
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dining scene in a café setting. The image features a table with a white tablecloth set with a bottle, plates of food, and utensils. Two figures are seated at the table, wearing formal attire, and appear engaged with the meal, while a third figure stands at the edge of the table. The surroundings are characterized by detailed line work suggesting a refined indoor ambiance with decorative architectural elements. Shading techniques have been used to convey depth and volume, creating focus on the central characters and their interaction with the table setting.

artworks.title: Quel dommage que cette charmante... femme...
artworks.description: The sketch depicts three men standing close together, shown from head to toe. One man is holding a thick stack of papers or a book. They have distinct facial features with prominent noses and wear tall, cylindrical hats. Their expressions are stoic but exaggerated, typical of caricatures. The men wear formal black coats similar to judicial robes and white shirts. A woman's back is visible, wearing a floor-length dress with a scarf or shawl over her head and shoulders, standing near a large column. The background shows a decorative architectural detail, implying an interior setting like a courthouse.

artworks.title: Mr. le Juge de paix a rendu sa décision...
artworks.description: The image is a black and white illustration depicting three main characters: two women and a judge. The women are in the foreground, showing from the waist up and facing each other. Both women have elderly facial features with lines and wide-open eyes. One woman wears a bonnet and gestures towards the other woman, who also wears a bonnet and has her hands clasped. They are dressed in attire typical of an older era, with shawls and striped skirts. In the background are two men in top hats looking at the women. On the right, the judge is seated at an elevated desk, wearing traditional attire, including a flat hat. The judge appears attentive, hands clasped on the desk. The background is shaded, suggesting an interior setting, likely a courtroom, with no extra details.

artworks.title: Un Plaideur peu satisfait
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring two figures in a justice-related setting. One figure is pointing upwards while the other, wearing a robe and cap, looks down sternly. The background includes large stacked documents or signs with words like "VENTE," "ETUDE," "JUGEMENT," and "JUCE." The artwork is detailed, with monochrome colors and expressive line work. The title "Un plaideur peu satisfait" translates to "An unsatisfied pleader." It is a 19th-century political or judicial cartoon.

artworks.title: Un Défenseur... causant... dans son cabinet habituel
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing in side profile. The man on the left is facing the viewer, wearing a top hat and glasses, with distinct facial features including a pointed nose and prominent cheekbones, short, curly hair, and is holding two glasses. The man on the right, facing away, wears a light-colored top hat and a long coat. The background suggests an interior setting with ornate paneling and an indistinct figure or object behind them.

artworks.title: Ainsi donc, quoique j'vous avoue...
artworks.description: The image shows two men from their knees upwards. The man on the left is in a sideways stance, gesturing with his hands. He has a prominent nose, thin lips, and short, curly hair. He is dressed in a black gown and wears a tall hat. The man on the right stands facing the first man, with his hands at his sides. He has a beard and longer unkempt hair. This man is dressed in a rough coat and pants. The background includes a bench and a plain wall, with text at the top and bottom related to legal or justice themes.

artworks.title: Plaidez... ça sera un bon tour a jouer...
artworks.description: The image shows two men from the waist up. The man on the left is leaning over a table, resting his face on one hand. He has a scruffy beard and curly hair under a wide-brimmed hat. The man on the right is gesturing with his right hand. He has a thin face, a receding hairline, wears pince-nez glasses, and has short, combed-back hair. In the background, there is a simple interior with a jug and a rectangular object on a surface.

artworks.title: Laissez dire un peu de mal de vous...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a courtroom scene. It depicts figures seated in a courtroom setting, with a central figure leaning towards another. Shadows and line work highlight a sense of solemnity and focus among the individuals, some wearing formal attire. In the background, a bench is visible where figures dressed in robes sit in authoritative postures. The caption at the bottom adds an element of dialogue or narrative. The monochrome execution emphasizes the seriousness typical of court proceedings.

artworks.title: Une Péroraison a la Démosthène
artworks.description: In the image, several men are shown in a courtroom setting. The central figure is standing in a dynamic pose, with one arm raised. Other men with distinctive features and clothing are around him. The background is sketchily drawn to represent a courtroom environment.

artworks.title: Encore perdu en Cour Royale... et il se lamente...
artworks.description: The image shows four men in full body standing close together. They appear to be engaged in a conversation. The men's facial features include prominent noses and lined wrinkles, indicating age. Their hair colors vary, and they wear formal attire with long robes and tall hats. One man holds a document or book. The background is plain, emphasizing the men, and the setting suggests a formal or judicial environment.

artworks.title: Vous avez perdu votre procès c'est vrai...
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals. The man on the right is in a confident stance with a smug expression on his face. He has a rounded face with closed eyes and a broad smile, and is wearing a black cap. He is dressed in a traditional black legal gown with a white cravat. To his left, another figure is bending forward, facing downward with their face obscured by a black gown and holding their head. Behind them, a small figure dressed in a dark suit and cap appears to be pulling or hiding behind the person's gown. The background has a plain wall with faint outlines of posters, giving the appearance of an interior setting.

artworks.title: Grand escalier du Palais de justice.  Vue de face
artworks.description: Two figures are shown on a set of stairs. The figure closest to the bottom has dark hair and a serious expression, wearing a dark robe with a white bib-like accessory, a brimmed cap, and carrying documents under one arm. The other figure, positioned further up the stairs, has light hair and a neutral expression, wearing a similar robe, neckpiece, and cap. The background shows stairs leading into a large building, with another figure ascending in the distance.

artworks.title: Il parait... que mon gaillard est un grand scélérat...
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in an interior setting. One person is positioned facing forward, while the other is turned slightly away. The first individual is wearing a dark robe and holding a scroll or document. They have distinct features including a prominent nose and chin, long, curly hair, and a flat cap. The second individual has their back to the viewer and is interacting with a door with a barred window. Another face is partially visible through the window. The background features blank walls, and a shadow on the floor indicates overhead lighting.
